nodes.summary: For every natural number $j$ and every real number $x$ with $|x| < 1$, the column generating function $\alpha_j$ of the infinite Pascal matrix satisfies $\alpha_j(x) = x^j / (1 - x)^{j+1}$.
nodes.title: Closed form of the Pascal column generating functions

nodes.summary: For a natural number $j$ and a real number $x$, the column generating function of the infinite Pascal matrix is $\alpha_j(x) = \sum_{i \ge 0} \binom{i}{j} x^i$, where $\binom{i}{j}$ is the entry in row $i$ and column $j$; the sum is taken to be $0$ when the series is not summable.
nodes.title: Column generating functions of the Pascal matrix

nodes.summary: For natural numbers $i$ and $j$, the entry of the infinite Pascal matrix in row $i$ and column $j$ is the binomial coefficient $\binom{i}{j}$.
nodes.title: Entries of the infinite Pascal matrix

nodes.summary: For every real number $x$ with $|x| < 1/2$, the sum $\sum_{j \ge 0} \alpha_j(x)$ of the column generating functions of the infinite Pascal matrix equals $\sum_{i \ge 0} (2x)^i$, and $\sum_{i \ge 0} (2x)^i = \frac{1}{1 - 2x}$.
nodes.title: Total generating function of the Pascal matrix

nodes.summary: For every real number $x$ with $|x| < 1/2$, the sum $\sum_{j \ge 0} \alpha_j(x)$ of the column generating functions of the infinite Pascal matrix equals $\sum_{j \ge 0} \sum_{i \ge 0} \binom{i}{j} x^i$, where $\binom{i}{j}$ is the entry in row $i$ and column $j$, and it also equals $\sum_{j \ge 0} x^j / (1 - x)^{j+1}$.
nodes.title: Summing the Pascal column generating functions

nodes.summary: For every real number $x$ with $|x| < 1/2$, writing $\binom{i}{j}$ for the entry of the infinite Pascal matrix in row $i$ and column $j$, we have $\sum_{j \ge 0} \sum_{i \ge 0} \binom{i}{j} x^i = \sum_{i \ge 0} \sum_{j \ge 0} \binom{i}{j} x^i$, and this sum equals $\frac{1}{1 - x} \sum_{j \ge 0} \left(\frac{x}{1 - x}\right)^j$.
nodes.title: Reversing the order of summation in the Pascal matrix

nodes.summary: For every real number $x$ with $|x| < 1/2$, writing $\binom{i}{j}$ for the entry of the infinite Pascal matrix in row $i$ and column $j$, we have $\sum_{i \ge 0} x^i \sum_{j=0}^{i} \binom{i}{j} = \frac{1}{1 - 2x}$.
nodes.title: Summing the Pascal matrix row by row

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
